notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have exciting news to share with you today...

The brand new Return 1.1 content update is out now!

The Door in the Badlands is now unlocked...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/b2ac01f0b8a96aa5aae1f4c9896f160f55f81d45.png[/img]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
[list]
[*]New locations to explore
[*]New enemies to fight
[*]New boss to defeat
[*]New weapon to wield
[*]New grimoire to discover
[*]New lore to read
[*]New achievements to unlock
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the new game + cutscene would play when starting a normal game
[*]Fixed a bug where the Armory achievement would not unlock 
[/list]

If you find any new bugs, be sure to report them in the [url=https://discord.gg/X5kdyhAXVu]Discord server[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/5ca563632c9f9867ac5d09034c8929665a8f7da5.png[/img]
[h2]New Key Art[/h2]
You may have noticed Return has some fresh cover art! We were hoping to have it completed for the launch of the game but unfortunately the deadline was too tight. So it's here for the 1.1 update in all it's glory!

Unfortunately, sales have not been high enough for us to pursue a Mac version at this time. We will be monitoring interest in the game and that may change in the future.

We will be porting the game to Switch over the coming months and are hoping to release early Q4.

On top of that we have also begin preproduction on our next title, more info to come soon.

So, what about Return? We will still be providing QOL updates and monitoring sales, if there is more interest in the game we will be adding more content in the future.


Thanks for reading, I hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Return Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/98dd1d89e350d300696cf927b86b5daac6b5d5f9.png[/img]
Hey everyone, this update includes QOL and NG+ changes.

Don't worry, you can still expect the content update at the end of the month!

Here is a list of changes:

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Battle Hardened" has been renamed to avoid confusion
[*] Added a new achievement
[/list]
[h2]Stamina[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stamina now replenishes to maximum on room transition
[/list]
[h2]Death[/h2]
[list]
[*] The death sound volume has been lowered
[/list]
[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now repeat the tutorial instructions until you complete the objective
[*] Fixed an issue where the rifle pickup was already loaded
[*] Fixed an issue where you could progress the tutorial without equipping the rifle
[*] Fixes an issue where weapons wouldn’t reset after finishing the tutorial
[/list]
[h2]Dialogue[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/b7bb07c36f0f3ac1d6892d08a13c5ca34bd5bcb9.png[/img]
[list]
[*] You now have to manually close a dialogue rather than it automatically closing after a period of time
[/list]
[h2]Map[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fast travel has been changed to pressing rather than holding the fast travel button
[/list]
[h2]New Game +[/h2]

To access NG+ you must have a save where you have completed the game

NG+ includes 2 new cutscenes

NG+ modifiers:
[list]
[*] Enemies deal 30% more damage
[*] Enemies drop 25% less REC
[*] Enemies drop 25% less XP
[*] Health stations will only heal to 50% of max health
[*] Dying will result in losing 10% of your REC
[/list]

Thanks for reading, let me know if you find any new bugs in the update!

notes.title: The Future of Return
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The launch of Return is well under way and we're glad to see you guys are enjoying the world so far. With that said, I want to address the major issue with the game, the length. Players are completing the game much faster than anticipated. 

I always envisioned Return as a slimmed down game without the need for much backtracking or reusing levels. As a consequence of this, the game has ended up too short.

I'm committed to improving the game and I want to make sure players feel like they get their money's worth. So as of this week I have begun working on a content update for Return. I can't say too much yet except that it will include the following:

- New Game Plus
- Boss Rush
- New Areas to Explore
- Quality of Life Fixes
- New Achievements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/e8d37eecc96ebc2eb6c842216d77b4c53ba3a338.png[/img]

With that said, unfortunately if sales don't perform well enough I will have to devote all my time to the next project. But don't worry, I will still be adding bug fixes and quality of life maintenance. 

Thanks for reading, see you guys in the next post.

notes.title: The Road to Launch
notes.content:
[h1]Responding to Demo Feedback + News[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/bda6b305347882c12ba9017f045b5e43e975f235.png[/img]

Hello everyone, this is my first proper post on Steam. Apologies for the lack of a communication on here, in case you didn't know I'm a one man team apart from my friend, Jake, who handles sound & music for the game. Sometimes my management duties get ahead of me but I plan to make up for it as we approach launch, so look out for more posts!

In this post I wanted to respond to feedback for the demo and talk about the road to launch. 

I want to give a huge thank you to everyone who tested the demo, so far [b]6000+[/b] people have played the demo on Steam. A lot of you also took the time to share feedback on the demo, which I will be addressing major points here, so let's dive in! 

[i]Scroll to the end if you want a summary of the game updates.[/i]

[h2]Responding to Demo Feedback[/h2]

[h3]Rebinding Keyboard Controls[/h3]

First off, a lot of people mentioned not being able to rebind keyboard controls, you can rebind controls, but unfortunately it wasn't clearly communicated how to do so. You can rebind controls by pressing the "enter" key, then choosing the key you wish to rebind to. It also features smart rebinding so it will automatically swap binds if a key has already been bound to something else. I will make sure it tells you this in the menu to alleviate the confusion.

[h3]Game Balance (Health, Ammo, and Combat)[/h3]
Next on the list of feedback is balance in terms of health, ammo, and combat. 

A common issue people brought up was that the game is unforgiving and in certain situations impossible because of lack of health. I had always envisioned a game where people who were struggling to progress could farm easier enemies to level up and gain max health. But I've come to realize the current risk vs reward of farming enemies is just not worth it. So to address this issue, at launch the game will have health perks you unlock as you level up to make progression easier and more rewarding. In the future I may also add perks that affect other parts of gameplay, but for now I want to keep perk scope small leading up to launch.

Another issue players faced was lack of ammo, since basic enemies respawn every time you re-enter a section of the world, ammo quickly becomes scarce when exploring. To fix this issue, enemies will now have a chance to drop ammo on death, the harder the enemy, the higher the chance of ammo. This will allow less experienced players to kill easier enemies in order to gear up for boss fights and exploration.

Lastly when it comes to balance is combat, most notably enemy attack animations and health. Players have mentioned that some of the enemies in the game are unbalanced and hard to fight, the worst offender being the Gravekeeper. To address this issue, I will be updating certain enemies attack animations with more windup frames to better telegraph attacks, and in contrast these attacks will do more damage. Making dodging easier but more detrimental if you fail. I will also be reevaluating basic stats for all the enemies to make sure the difficulty progression throughout the game is more steady.

[h3]Saving[/h3]

Another problem mentioned by players is that in certain boss rooms, the doors become locked and you cannot progress further because the game saved when you were low on health. All boss rooms will now let you leave them at any time if you are not engaged with the boss. Players also mentioned the items/weapons they equipped and upgraded before fighting bosses would not save, now if there are no enemies present in your current room the game will save after you make changes in the inventory. The game will also clearly communicate that boss rooms are a no save zone, so if you want to make changes in your inventory you must do so outside.

[h3]Window Resolutions[/h3]

Next up, players have had issues when the game launches larger than their monitor resolution and they are unable to change the game to fullscreen. The game will now feature a broad range of support for resolutions and will launch in the smallest windowed mode if the game can't auto detect your resolution.

[h2]Summary of Changes[/h2]

The issues mentioned above were the most common when I read feedback for the demo, I plan to address all of them for the final version. Below is a summary of changes I've made to the game since the demo launched.

[list]
[*]Keys are rebindable but this was not clearly communicated in the menu before.
[*]Health perks can be unlocked to balance progression and make gameplay more rewarding.
[*]Enemies will now have a chance to drop ammo on death in order to gear up for boss fights and exploration.
[*]Certain enemy animations will be updated to make attacks telegraph better.
[*]All enemy base stats will be rebalanced.
[*]Boss rooms will now let you leave if you are not engaged with the boss allowing you to escape unfavorable situations.
[*]Inventory will now save changes anytime if no enemies are present.
[*]Boss rooms now clearly communicate that saving is not allowed in them until the boss is defeated.
[*]More resolutions have been added and better resolution support has been implemented.
[*]Localization for major languages.
[*]New English font for better legibility.
[*]Pressing "escape" no longer opens the options menu when inside other menus (inventory, shop, map, console, etc.)
[*]NPC voice sounds.
[*]Fixed an issues where item controls were not showing when an item slot was empty.
[*]And much more to be discovered!
[/list]

Unfortunately at this time I will not be updating the beta demo of the game before launch, it just isn't feasible with launch around the corner. That being said, I will be looking for playtesters for the full game in the coming months so keep your eyes out for that!

I greatly appreciate all the feedback given from players and I will strive to make this game as good as possible! If you think I missed anything, be sure to leave your feedback in my [url=https://discord.gg/X5kdyhAXVu]Discord[/url] server.

[h2]The Road to Launch[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41684429/ec34f17d89cff3eacb85901e944605025e60bc37.png[/img]

Last week be hit a huge milestone, [b]20,000[/b] Steam wishlists! I want to thank the amazing community around Return for continuing to support my work for the better half of 2 years. So much has changed in that time and you guys are helping me live my dream of being a game developer. I dropped out of University in April 2021 and to be launching my game 2 years later is unbelievable.

In case you didn't know, I've moved the launch date for Return to the later half of Q2 2023, I'm extremely excited for you to experience the world of Return in it's entirety! 

That's it for this post, look forward to more updates + announcements as we reach the launch of Return! 

Make sure to follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/DeadUnicornYYC]Twitter[/url] to see the latest in-game updates!
